title: Cannot import multi dot extensions
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]
 Only tested with 4.5.1 because this feature was implemented in 4.5 in PR #100086

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 125.3 GiB memory

### Issue description

I would like to write an import plugin that recognizes `nii` and `nii.gz` files. This feature should be supported according to PR #100086

I believe the issue is that the PR forgot about the following lines:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f62fdbde15035c5576dad93e586201f4d41ef0cb/editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp#L1213-L1217

Here the system filters out the file before the function `_can_import_file` that would report `true` for the file in question.

The implemented solution only works if there is already an importer for the very last extension. For my example of importing `.nii.gz` I would need to already have an importer for `gz` in order to populate the `valid_extensions` hash set.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project
- Create a custom `EditorImportPlugin`
- Set the recognized extensions to have multiple parts
- Create an `EditorPlugin` that adds this editor import plugin
- Enable the plugin
- Create a file with the multi part extension
- Observe that the file is not recognized

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MultiDotExtensionsBug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24585600/MultiDotExtensionsBug.zip)
